What is perplexity?

The official desktop client for Perplexity, an AI answer engine that searches the web and returns a synthesized, source-cited response rather than just a list of results. The desktop app adds OS-level conveniences such as screenshot-to-search and quick access to chat and research directly from your desktop, on top of Perplexity's usual free and paid web features.

Install perplexity on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add perplexity

Good to know

  • A Perplexity account (free or paid)
  • Network access
  • A paid subscription for advanced models, higher limits, and some premium features
